author: yulinkservices
title: Looking for Graphic Artist (Remote, Commission-Based)
content: 📣 We’re Looking for a Graphic Artist (Remote, Commission-Based) 📣 📍What You’ll Do: -Transform customer-provided JPEG logos or artwork into high-quality, production-ready designs quickly and efficiently, without relying on AutoTrace or equivalent programs. 📍What We Are Looking For: -Minimum of 2 years of vector design experience in Adobe Illustrator CS6 or higher, supported by a strong portfolio. -Excellent organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. Must be able to multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment and pay close attention to detail. -Must have a reliable internet connection suitable for remote work. -Willingness to use time-tracking software. -Available for the graveyard shift (11 PM to 8 AM PHT, Monday to Friday). -Open to Filipino citizens only. 📍Additional Information: -This is a remote, commission-based role paid per artwork. -Earnings can reach up to ₱38,000 per month or more, depending on the number of artworks you complete. The more you finish, the more you earn. -Paid training provided during the first 6 weeks. -This is a performance-based role, where your earnings reflect your speed, quality, and dedication. 📩 Send your resume and portfolio to: yulinkhr@gmail.com 📌 Subject line: Graphic Artist – [Your Full Name]

author: afrolatinoeducation
title: Seeking Black Puerto Rican female illustrator for commission
content: Tag a Black Puerto Rican female illustrator. 🇵🇷🎨 PLEASE READ BEFORE SUBMITTING: As the Afro-Latino Education & Arts Collective, part of our mission is creating intentional opportunities for Black-identifying Latino artists and creatives. This particular commission is specifically seeking a Black-identifying Puerto Rican female illustrator. Puerto Rican heritage alone does not meet the criteria for this particular commission. Having African ancestry or Black relatives is also not the same as personally identifying as Black. We ask that applicants please respect the specificity of this opportunity so that space intentionally created for Black Puerto Rican female artists remains available to Black Puerto Rican female artists. Thank you for respecting the intention of the commission.
